# Firestore Schema & Data Models

## Overview

This document describes the Firestore database structure, data models, and example documents for the community web app.

## Collections

### 1. `users`
Stores user profiles and preferences.

**Document ID:** User's Firebase Auth UID

### 2. `goals`
Stores user goals and tasks.

**Document ID:** Auto-generated by Firestore

### 3. `globalStats`
Stores community-wide statistics.

**Document ID:** `current` (single document)

---

## Data Models

### User Model

**Collection:** `users`
**Document ID:** Firebase Auth UID
**TypeScript Interface:** `User` (see `src/types/models.ts`)

#### Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | ✅ | User's unique identifier (Firebase Auth UID) |
| `email` | string | ✅ | User's email address |
| `displayName` | string | ✅ | User's display name from Google |
| `photoURL` | string \| null | ⬜ | URL to profile picture |
| `googleAccessToken` | string \| null | ⬜ | OAuth token for Calendar API |
| `tokenExpiresAt` | Timestamp \| null | ⬜ | When the token expires |
| `goalsCount` | number | ✅ | Total goals created |
| `goalsCompletedCount` | number | ✅ | Total goals completed |
| `currentStreak` | number | ✅ | Current streak in days |
| `longestStreak` | number | ✅ | Longest streak in days |
| `lastCompletionDate` | Timestamp \| null | ⬜ | Last goal completion date |
| `calendarConnected` | boolean | ✅ | Whether Calendar is connected |
| `timezone` | string | ✅ | User's timezone |
| `notificationPreferences` | object | ✅ | Notification settings |
| `notificationPreferences.email` | boolean | ✅ | Email notifications enabled |
| `notificationPreferences.reminders` | boolean | ✅ | Goal reminders enabled |
| `notificationPreferences.weeklySummary` | boolean | ✅ | Weekly summary enabled |
| `createdAt` | Timestamp | ✅ | Account creation timestamp |
| `updatedAt` | Timestamp | ✅ | Last update timestamp |

#### Indexes Needed

```javascript
// Composite index for querying active users
Collection: users
Fields: lastCompletionDate (Descending), createdAt (Descending)

// For leaderboard queries
Collection: users
Fields: currentStreak (Descending), goalsCompletedCount (Descending)
```

### Goal Model

**Collection:** `goals`
**Document ID:** Auto-generated
**TypeScript Interface:** `Goal` (see `src/types/models.ts`)

#### Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | ✅ | Goal's unique identifier |
| `userId` | string | ✅ | User who created this goal |
| `title` | string | ✅ | Goal title |
| `description` | string | ✅ | Detailed description |
| `category` | GoalCategory | ✅ | Category (personal, work, health, etc.) |
| `status` | GoalStatus | ✅ | Status (todo, in_progress, completed, etc.) |
| `priority` | GoalPriority | ✅ | Priority (low, medium, high, urgent) |
| `startDate` | Timestamp | ✅ | When goal starts |
| `dueDate` | Timestamp | ✅ | Target completion date |
| `completedAt` | Timestamp \| null | ⬜ | When goal was completed |
| `recurring` | boolean | ✅ | Whether goal repeats |
| `recurrencePattern` | object \| null | ⬜ | Recurrence details |
| `calendarEventId` | string \| null | ⬜ | Google Calendar event ID |
| `tags` | string[] | ✅ | Tags for filtering |
| `isPublic` | boolean | ✅ | Counts toward global stats |
| `daysUntilDue` | number | ✅ | Computed: days until due |
| `isOverdue` | boolean | ✅ | Computed: is overdue |
| `notes` | string | ✅ | Additional notes |
| `createdAt` | Timestamp | ✅ | Creation timestamp |
| `updatedAt` | Timestamp | ✅ | Last update timestamp |

#### GoalCategory Values
- `personal` - Personal development
- `work` - Work-related goals
- `health` - Health and fitness
- `learning` - Education and skills
- `social` - Social activities
- `finance` - Financial goals
- `other` - Other categories

#### GoalStatus Values
- `todo` - Not started
- `in_progress` - Currently working on
- `completed` - Finished successfully
- `cancelled` - Cancelled by user
- `archived` - Archived for history

#### GoalPriority Values
- `low` - Low priority
- `medium` - Medium priority
- `high` - High priority
- `urgent` - Urgent, needs immediate attention

#### Indexes Needed

```javascript
// Get user's goals ordered by due date
Collection: goals
Fields: userId (Ascending), dueDate (Ascending)

// Get user's goals by status
Collection: goals
Fields: userId (Ascending), status (Ascending), dueDate (Ascending)

// Get overdue goals
Collection: goals
Fields: userId (Ascending), isOverdue (Ascending), dueDate (Ascending)

// Get public goals for stats
Collection: goals
Fields: isPublic (Ascending), status (Ascending), category (Ascending)
```

### GlobalStats Model

**Collection:** `globalStats`
**Document ID:** `current` (single document)
**TypeScript Interface:** `GlobalStats` (see `src/types/models.ts`)

#### Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | ✅ | Always "current" |
| `totalUsers` | number | ✅ | Total registered users |
| `totalGoals` | number | ✅ | Total goals created |
| `totalGoalsCompleted` | number | ✅ | Total goals completed |
| `totalGoalsInProgress` | number | ✅ | Goals currently active |
| `completionRate` | number | ✅ | Completion percentage |
| `activeUsersLast7Days` | number | ✅ | Active users (7 days) |
| `activeUsersLast30Days` | number | ✅ | Active users (30 days) |
| `goalsCompletedToday` | number | ✅ | Goals completed today |
| `goalsCompletedThisWeek` | number | ✅ | Goals completed this week |
| `goalsCompletedThisMonth` | number | ✅ | Goals completed this month |
| `popularCategory` | GoalCategory | ✅ | Most popular category |
| `categoryDistribution` | object | ✅ | Goals by category |
| `statusDistribution` | object | ✅ | Goals by status |
| `averageGoalsPerUser` | number | ✅ | Average goals per user |
| `averageCompletionTimeDays` | number | ✅ | Avg completion time |
| `highestStreak` | number | ✅ | Highest streak recorded |
| `highestStreakUserId` | string \| null | ⬜ | User with highest streak |
| `lastUpdated` | Timestamp | ✅ | Last stats update |
| `createdAt` | Timestamp | ✅ | Creation timestamp |
| `updatedAt` | Timestamp | ✅ | Last update timestamp |

## Security Rules

Example Firestore security rules:

```javascript
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    // Helper functions
    function isAuthenticated() {
      return request.auth != null;
    }

    function isOwner(userId) {
      return request.auth.uid == userId;
    }

    // Users collection
    match /users/{userId} {
      // Anyone can read user profiles
      allow read: if isAuthenticated();

      // Only the user can write their own profile
      allow write: if isAuthenticated() && isOwner(userId);
    }

    // Goals collection
    match /goals/{goalId} {
      // Users can read their own goals
      allow read: if isAuthenticated() &&
                     resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;

      // Users can create goals for themselves
      allow create: if isAuthenticated() &&
                       request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;

      // Users can update/delete their own goals
      allow update, delete: if isAuthenticated() &&
                               resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;
    }

    // Global stats (read-only for users)
    match /globalStats/{statsId} {
      allow read: if isAuthenticated();
      allow write: if false; // Only Cloud Functions can write
    }
  }
}
```

## Data Flow

### Creating a New User

1. User signs in with Google OAuth
2. Firebase Auth creates user account
3. Create user document in `users` collection:
   ```typescript
   const newUser: CreateUser = {
     email: user.email,
     displayName: user.displayName,
     photoURL: user.photoURL,
     googleAccessToken: accessToken,
     tokenExpiresAt: expiryTimestamp,
     goalsCount: 0,
     goalsCompletedCount: 0,
     currentStreak: 0,
     longestStreak: 0,
     lastCompletionDate: null,
     calendarConnected: true,
     timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
     notificationPreferences: {
       email: true,
       reminders: true,
       weeklySummary: true,
     },
   };
   ```
4. Update `globalStats.totalUsers`

### Creating a Goal

1. User creates goal via UI
2. Calculate `daysUntilDue` and `isOverdue`
3. Create goal document in `goals` collection
4. Increment `users/{userId}.goalsCount`
5. Update `globalStats.totalGoals`
6. If `calendarConnected`, sync to Google Calendar

### Completing a Goal

1. User marks goal as completed
2. Update goal: `status = 'completed'`, `completedAt = now()`
3. Increment `users/{userId}.goalsCompletedCount`
4. Update user streak (check `lastCompletionDate`)
5. Update `globalStats.totalGoalsCompleted`
6. Update category and status distributions

---

## Collection Estimates (Free Tier)

Firebase free tier limits:
- **Firestore**: 1 GiB storage, 50K reads/day, 20K writes/day

Estimated document sizes:
- User: ~1 KB
- Goal: ~2 KB
- GlobalStats: ~1 KB

For 1000 users with 10 goals each:
- Storage: (1000 × 1KB) + (10000 × 2KB) + 1KB ≈ 21 MB
- Well within free tier! ✅
